label: prop:jackson-q-bessel-contiguity-recurrence
title: First-order contiguity recurrence for the Jackson first- and second-kind $q$-Bessel coefficients (fibre-level)
html: Let J_ u^{(1)}(x;q) and J_ u^{(2)}(x;q) be Jackson's first- and second-kind q-Bessel functions. Their power-series coefficients satisfy purely algebraic first-order contiguity recurrences in the order u. The recurrence is algebraic in the formal deformation variable q. The q-weights are adapted to the SU_q(1,1) Casimir invariants. This fibre-level identity fixes the radial coefficient algebra without fixing the binding scale.
heading: Proposition
